description: Phase 1: LLM Macro Agent + Knowledge Graph + RAG — closes the biggest SOTA gap by wiring 37 existing agent prompts into runtime tool-use

userStories.title: LLM Macro Agent runtime scaffold
userStories.description: As the scanner, I need an LLM agent that queries macro APIs and emits structured AgentVerdicts so it can vote in the ensemble.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/scanner/agents/llm_macro_agent.py exists with LLMMacroAgent class
Inherits from ScannerAgentTeam agent pattern (emits AgentVerdict)
Uses Instructor + Pydantic for structured output (not free-text)
Tool-use: queries FRED API for policy rates, BIS for REER
Response cached per (prompt_id, date) to avoid API costs
Shadow mode: votes are logged but do NOT affect ensemble score
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Macro Knowledge Graph static scaffold
userStories.description: As the LLM Macro Agent, I need a structured graph of macro relationships so I can reason about contagion and regime shifts.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/intelligence/macro_knowledge_graph.py exists
Static graph with entities: central_banks, currencies, economies, commodities
Relations: hikes_rates → appreciates_against, cuts_rates → depreciates_against, geopolitical_shock → safe_haven_flow
Graph is queryable by entity name and relation type
JSON serialization for persistence
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: RAG module for historical macro analogies
userStories.description: As the LLM Macro Agent, I need retrieval-augmented generation so I can cite historical analogies in my reasoning.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/intelligence/macro_rag.py exists
Ingests: FOMC statements, ECB minutes, BoJ minutes (plaintext)
Chunking: paragraph-level with overlap
Embedding: uses lightweight sentence-transformers (all-MiniLM-L6-v2)
Vector store: flat numpy index (no external DB dependency)
Retrieval: top-k similar chunks for a query string
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Central bank audio tone processor
userStories.description: As the scanner, I need to extract sentiment and hesitation from central bank press conference audio so the LLM agent has multi-modal input.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/intelligence/cb_audio_processor.py exists
Ingests audio file or URL (Powell/Ueda/Bailey pressers)
Whisper-large-v3 transcription (optional dependency — graceful fallback if unavailable)
Tone metrics: speaking_rate, pause_frequency, pitch_variance (via librosa)
Hesitation detection: filler-word count, false-start count
Output: normalized dovish/hawkish/neutral score (-1 to +1)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Integration with ScannerAgentTeam
userStories.description: As the scanner, I want the LLM Macro Agent to participate in ensemble voting when enabled, with full observability.
acceptanceCriteria: ScannerConfig gains enable_llm_macro_agent: bool = False
ScannerAgentTeam.evaluate() calls LLMMacroAgent when flag is True
Shadow mode: when flag is False but enable_llm_macro_shadow=True, votes are logged to journal with tag 'shadow_llm'
Weave tracing: LLM latency, token usage, tool-call success rate
Error handling: API failure → fallback to neutral verdict, no crash
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Historical shadow validation
userStories.description: As the operator, I want to know if the LLM Macro Agent would have correctly warned before known macro events.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_llm_macro_shadow.py exists
Runs the agent against historical events (July 2024 BoJ hike, Sept 2024 Fed cut, etc.)
Outputs: agent verdict, reasoning, retrieved analogies, tone scores
Comparison: did the agent signal regime_shift_probability > 0.7 before the event?
Report written to trained_data/reports/llm_macro_shadow_validation.md
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
